## What's new

A bugfix release. No features changed in this build.

**The last row in a folder could be hidden behind the status bar.** A symlink
row is taller than the rest, because it carries its target on a second line.
The list sized itself as *row count × 22 pt*, which is only right when every row
is a plain row. In a folder with enough links, the table stopped short and the
rows below it could not be scrolled into view.

The list now takes its height from the rows it actually draws, so the last row
is always reachable, whether the rows are plain, links, or search results. The
unit tests still pass.

## Installing

Download `RoachExplorer-v0.1.4a.zip`, unzip it, and drag **Roach Explorer** into
Applications. The app is ad-hoc signed, so the first launch may need
right-click → Open. Verify the download with the SHA-256 file next to it:

```sh
shasum -a 256 -c RoachExplorer-v0.1.4a.zip.sha256
```

Requires macOS 14 or later.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/HenzeLars/RoachExplorer/compare/v0.1.4...v0.1.4a
